newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli male longevity third in world despite war.
newsitem.headline: Israeli male longevity third in world despite war.

text.p: Despite deaths in battle or in the tangle of Israeli traffic, Israeli men still live longer, on average, than men in all but two other countries, according to a new report.
"War casualties -- each one is very bad -- but luckily they...don't change our death rate," David Neumann of Israel's Central Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
He declined to explain why Israeli men, who serve in reserve army units into their 50s, live so long.
Israeli men on average live to be 75.5 years old, slightly less than Swedes and a full year less than Japanese men, who rank first at 76.5 years. American men live only 72.2 years on average.
Israeli women rank 17th among the world's women, but still live longer than Israeli men, reaching an average of 79.1 years. Japanese women live to be 83.1 years old, and Americans 78.8.
